Module sudoku
Package sudoku.model

Class MoveResult

java.lang.Object
sudoku.model.MoveResult
public final class MoveResult extends Object
Result of a move made by the player. It tells whether the move was applied, whether it follows the Sudoku rules, which cells are in conflict, and a message to show. It cannot be changed after it is created.
